d: Viju lives near Panji, Goa, with his poor mother who teaches music to make a living. Mary, sister of a rich landlord David comes home from Bombay to visit her family during her vacations. The two characters fall in love with each other. On getting to know this, David beats Mary black-and-blue and plans to get her married . During these events, David violates his maid and cleanly gets away with it. But this earns him his wife's wrath, and she tries to help Mary unite with Viju against the wishes of David.
